Design not required: no UI behaviour requested; AGENTS.md pre-decides all visuals.

openQuestions.question: How should this agent test conclude? A (recommended): end the run here with the planning artifacts as the deliverable and no branch on terminal-portfolio. B: re-request as a real feature 'minimal verifiable reference app' supplying identity data (name, handle, role, email, socials, palette); tasks T-B01..T-B05 then apply. C: a platform owner re-pins the pipeline so unit/lint/integration/e2e are not required for this test (the repository cannot do this itself).

validation.description: terminal-portfolio is unchanged relative to main (AC-001)
task-plan.json is valid schemaVersion 1 JSON with an acyclic dependsOn graph and every cited AC/R ID present in requirements.md (AC-002)
validation.command: python3 -I -c 'import json,re; P="/workspace/.hub/specs/spec/005-agent-tab-new/"; p=json.load(open(P+"task-plan.json")); assert p["schemaVersion"]==1; dep={t["id"]:set(t["dependsOn"]) for t in p["tasks"]}; assert all(d in dep for ds in dep.values() for d in ds), "unknown dependsOn"; rem=dict(dep); [rem.pop(k) for _ in range(len(dep)) for k in list(rem) if not rem[k] & set(rem)]; assert not rem, ("cycle", sorted(rem)); req=open(P+"requirements.md").read(); cited={m for t in p["tasks"] for a in t["acceptanceCriteria"] for m in re.findall(r"\b(?:AC|R)-\d{3}\b", a)}; missing=sorted(c for c in cited if c not in req); assert not missing, missing; print("ok", sorted(cited))'
